proves.claim: On one fixture the gate record of a submit with submit.composeOnRunner on equals the record with it off.

cli.io-submit-handoff-compose-on-runner..why: Without it the runner-composed gate could record a different tree than a direct run and nobody would notice.

proves.claim: With main moved after the claim, both composeOnRunner modes compose the same tree.

cli.io-submit-handoff-compose-on-runner..why: Without it a moved main could make the two modes prove different trees.
